patterns: Parallel container builds (19) consistently hit timeout/lock contention with pnpm-store. pnpm-store is a single shared file-lock.
When modifying site templates via patch, ALWAYS validate the substitution against the actual file structure (e.g. 'use client' must be first line, not after imports).
Traefik routing for non-standard paths requires the rule to be IN the leads-api service, with priority >= 100 to override paragu-ai-builder.
ES modules (import) and CommonJS (require) are NOT mixable.
docker stack deploy on existing services needs explicit --force or risks 'service already exists' error.
insights: leads-api has become the API gateway for ~6 features. Worth health monitoring + alerting.
Sites use different file structures (some 'use client', some server components). Wiring client components is fragile because the directive must be FIRST LINE.
2 leads already captured shows the system is COLLECTING real data. The next 5 leads will be the conversion test.
